what: The published list of reporters: the courier carries a game only when its reporters are exactly this list. It is a file in this repository, changed by a reviewed commit, and is never read from the chain's approved list.
note: One address today: the reporter the games set on Polygon holds for every game it has created, as read on chain in November 2026. The build that reads this file against a game's reporters is the orders build; this build ships the list.
